summary: Inventiva S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a proxy card and voting instructions for its Ordinary and Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for June 30, 2026. The filing covers routine items including approval of statutory and consolidated financial statements, appropriation of profit/loss, approval of expenses, ratification of a subscription agreement with Samsara BioCapital, and say-on-pay for the chairman and former/current CEOs. This is a standard proxy solicitation for an annual/extraordinary meeting with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event is present.
